The data presented herein covers the period of January 1 through December 31, 2025 (Calendar Year 2025).
Total aggregate payments received ($812.9 million) exceed aggregate acquisition costs ($399.1 million), yielding a gross program margin of approximately $413.7 million.

For Calendar Year 2025, Idaho covered entities collectively reported nearly 1.92 million prescription drugs obtained under the 340B program and dispensed to patients, generating over $812.9 million in aggregate payments received, while directing $430.6 million in 340B savings toward charity care, community benefit programs, and services for indigent patients.

Covered entities with child sites (physically separate, off-site outpatient facility, or clinic associated or affiliated with the covered entity) submitted their child site data in aggregate with the parent site data.
For CY2025, the total aggregate acquisition cost across all Idaho covered entities was $399,146,308.13.
For CY2025, the total aggregate payments received by all Idaho 340B covered entities was $812,855,944.90.
For CY2025, Idaho covered entities made total aggregate payments to contract pharmacies of $46,157,188.85.
For CY2025, Idaho covered entities collectively reported 1,916,995 total claims across all payer categories.
Commercial insurance was the dominant payer category, accounting for 45.4% of all claims, followed by Medicare at 31.1%.
For CY2025, Idaho covered entities directed a total of $430,646,950.35 in 340B savings.

*Ten entities reported Additional/Other uses of their 340B program savings. The majority of other uses were for capital improvement projects, pharmacy staff salary and benefits, 340B program administration staff necessary for program compliance, and third-party administration (TPA) costs related to participating in the 340B program. Some entities reported other use of their savings. Idaho Code § 41-351 requires this report to remain aggregated and confidential. Including these details may identify individual entities and compromise confidentiality.

The CY2025 data submitted pursuant to Idaho Code § 41-351 demonstrates that Idaho's 340B covered entities collectively process nearly 1.92 million claims, generating $812.9 million in aggregate payments received for 340B drugs from payers and patients, with an acquisition cost of $399.1 million for the drugs, and directs $430.6 million in 340B program savings toward community benefit programs.
